claim: a DUF1631 protein has a measurable cellular function
finding: pacR (AAW18_RS04175) mutant: decreased attachment, EPS, hypersensitive response, virulence; reduced membrane integrity and OMV production; 225 genes differentially expressed
context: Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris Xc17, plant infection and in vitro assays
confidence: moderate for the phenotype, none for a molecular activity; pleiotropic, loss-of-function only, different genus

claim: a DUF1631 protein contributes to fitness in planta
finding: XC_3388, DUF1631, reported as important for adaptation and virulence, suggested link to c-di-GMP regulation
confidence: moderate; competitive fitness only, mechanism not established, different genus

claim: the DUF1631 region adopts an identifiable fold with a catalytic constellation
finding: modules 25-217, 285-433 and 465-578 are all-alpha bundles with no significant match (best E 0.63, 3.18, 1.89; prob 0.38, 0.12, 0.15); region 585-719 matches Royal/Tudor beta-barrels at E 0.0023-0.016, prob 0.975-1.0, dominated by ProQ orthologues; no catalytic triad, metal site or phosphate pocket anywhere
confidence: high for absence of enzymatic/nucleotide-binding folds; fold assignment is prediction, not assay

claim: the C-terminal Tudor domain reads methylated lysine or arginine
finding: PP_0788 628-700 has 4 aromatics and no 3-ring cage at any threshold (closest pair F668-W679, 4.9 A); SMN, LBR, PHF19, 3PNW and Spindlin-2B all have cages at 3.9-6.8 A with 6-30 aromatics; both bacterial ProQ CTDs also lack a cage
context: AlphaFold model plus five experimental PDB structures, identical code
confidence: high; geometry measured on a predicted model for the query

claim: the ampD-ampE adjacency of PP_0788 is more than incidental gene order
finding: AmpD within +/-2 genes in 10/63 genomes vs 1/63 in a matched 4-10 gene distal control (Fisher one-sided OR 11.70, p=0.0043, BH q=0.012); same-strand immediately downstream in 7/63. NadC 11/63 (q=0.0033), SecD and SecF 8/63 (q=0.011), DprA 7/63 (q=0.014), PilZ 6/63 (q=0.025)
context: NCBI IPG coordinates plus nuccore feature tables, 1438 neighbouring CDS
confidence: moderate-high for the association; a minority pattern (16%), so not a family-defining operon

claim: PP_0788 lies upstream of ampD and ampE in KT2440
finding: PP_0788 903742-905901 (+), 88 bp gap, ampD PP_RS04190 905990-906562 (+), ampE PP_RS04195 906559-907389 (+) overlapping ampD by 4 bp; nadC is divergent 243 bp upstream
confidence: high; operon inference from strand and spacing, no transcript evidence retrieved

citation: this work: Pfam/UniProt architecture scan, 2720 PF07793 proteins

confidence: moderate; sequence-level only, a weak test for ancient repeats
